column1: # The Z-stats attribute page's own field labels.
# the rest of the character page have never appeared in a sampled stock
# frame. `zstats-pages` walks the pages but samples the roster panel and
# message window, not the page body, so the labels themselves are unchecked.
# `inventory.md` Section 4.7 has the attribute page clear the whole panel and
# own that window, so these land in the panel region the comparator already
# decodes - they just needed a scenario that stops on the page.
# requires-seed: a save placed beside Britain's fountain
